# perceptdot — Full Technical Reference

> Give your AI eyes. AI Visual QA for CI/CD and MCP-compatible AI tools.

## What is perceptdot?

perceptdot is an AI-powered visual QA tool that catches layout bugs automatically on every deploy. It takes headless screenshots using Cloudflare Browser Rendering API and analyzes them with Gemini 2.5 Flash vision AI. Results are structured JSON with severity levels, affected CSS selectors, and actionable fix suggestions.

No desktop required. No GUI. Runs in CI/CD pipelines, MCP servers, and REST API calls.

## Problem it Solves

AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot) write code fast but cannot see the visual output. CSS bugs, layout shifts, overflow issues, and responsive breakage go unnoticed until a human reviews. perceptdot gives these AI tools visual perception — they can now verify their own output.

Unlike Computer Use or desktop-based tools, perceptdot is fully headless and works in:
- GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / any CI pipeline
- MCP-compatible AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline)
- Direct REST API calls
- Docker containers and serverless environments

## Core API: visual_check

```
POST https://api.perceptdot.com/v1/eye/check
Content-Type: application/json
X-Percept-Key: YOUR_API_KEY

{
  "url": "https://your-preview-url.vercel.app",
  "viewport": "desktop",
  "full_page": true
}
```

Response (structured JSON):
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "has_issues": true,
  "summary": "Pricing card text overflows its container.",
  "issues": [
    { "severity": "high", "description": ".pricing-card:nth-child(2) text overflows card boundary", "tile_index": 0 }
  ],
  "dom_issues": [],
  "tiles_analyzed": 1,
  "credits_used": 1,
  "quota_remaining": 99,
  "duration_ms": 7100
}
```

## MCP Server (for AI tools)

Transport: Streamable HTTP
Endpoint: https://mcp.perceptdot.com/mcp

Install in Claude Code:
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http perceptdot https://mcp.perceptdot.com/mcp --header "X-Percept-Key: YOUR_KEY"
```

Available MCP tool:
- `visual_check` — screenshot + AI analysis of any URL (inputs: url, prompt, viewport, no_cache)

Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json):
```json
{"mcpServers":{"perceptdot":{"url":"https://mcp.perceptdot.com/mcp","headers":{"X-Percept-Key":"YOUR_KEY"}}}}
```

Windsurf (~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json):
```json
{"mcpServers":{"perceptdot":{"serverUrl":"https://mcp.perceptdot.com/mcp","headers":{"X-Percept-Key":"YOUR_KEY"}}}}
```

## GitHub Action

```yaml
name: Visual QA
on: [deployment_status]
jobs:
  visual-check:
    if: github.event.deployment_status.state == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: perceptdot/percept/eye-action@v1.0.0
        with:
          url: ${{ github.event.deployment_status.target_url }}
          api_key: ${{ secrets.PERCEPT_API_KEY }}
          # fail_on_issue: true   # optional
```

## Legacy packages

@perceptdot/ga4, vercel, github, sentry and core belong to an earlier product and are no longer maintained.

OpenAPI spec: https://perceptdot.com/openapi.json

## Pricing

1 credit = 1 tile = a 1280×1600 px slice of the page. A short page is about 1 credit, a long landing page about 3–5 credits. About 7 seconds for a typical page, up to ~20 seconds for long pages.

| Plan | Price | Credits/month | Status |
|------|-------|---------------|--------|
| Free | $0 | 100 (+100 one-time bonus after feedback; resets on the 1st, UTC) | Available, no credit card |
| Pro | $19/mo | 10,000 | Coming Soon |
| Team | $49/mo | 30,000 (fair use) | Coming Soon |

Payments are handled by Paddle.

## Architecture

```
Client (MCP / REST API / GitHub Action)
  → Cloudflare Workers (Hono framework, TypeScript)
    → Cloudflare Browser Rendering (headless Chromium screenshot)
    → Gemini 2.5 Flash (vision AI analysis)
  → Structured JSON response
```

- Screenshots are not stored. Analysis results (summary and issues, never screenshots) are cached for up to 10 minutes per URL and viewport
- Screenshots are sent to Google (Gemini API) and Cloudflare (Workers AI, fallback). Google may use data sent to unpaid Gemini API tiers to improve its products, so do not check pages containing personal data
- Edge-deployed globally via Cloudflare Workers
- MCP protocol: Anthropic standard, streamable HTTP transport

## Comparison with Alternatives

| Feature | perceptdot | Computer Use | Playwright screenshots |
|---------|-----------|-------------|----------------------|
| Headless (no GUI) | Yes | No | Yes |
| AI analysis | Yes | Partial | No |
| CI/CD native | Yes | No | Yes |
| MCP integration | Yes | No | No |
| Structured findings | Yes | No | No |
| Pricing | Free 100 credits/month | n/a | Free (no analysis) |
